observations.behavior: Adds an ORM signal receiver that deletes orphaned IdentityProviderConfigs when their parent OrganizationDomain is deleted.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents dangling configuration records from persisting after associated domains are removed. P1.P6 and P1.P5 show this behavior is also tested for both migrations and runtime deletion.

observations.behavior: Defines cleanup criteria: only delete unlinked configs older than 1 day; preserves recently-created ones still awaiting linkage.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces database bloat while avoiding false positives during legitimate multi-request identity setup flows. P1.P4 registers this as a baseline test case.

observations.behavior: Tests the domain-deletion path explicitly removes linked-to-domain config but retains one attached to another domain.
observations.posthog_connection: Confirms correct scoping of orphan removal without collateral damage. P1.P6 similarly checks migration-only behavior with backdated entries.

observations.limitations: Only backend changes reviewed; no frontend or API compatibility assertions supplied in chunk. Tier relies on model and migration implementation rather than complete end-to-end verification.

review.limitations: Only backend changes reviewed; no frontend or API compatibility assertions supplied in chunk. Tier relies on model and migration implementation rather than complete end-to-end verification.
review.reason: Adds bounded correctness improvement (orphan cleanup) with tests and migration safeguards. Not tier-3 because it does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across multiple components or critical paths.
review.posthog_relevance: Preserves data integrity for SAML/identity configurations by removing dangling records after their parent domains are deleted.
review.uncertainty: Chunk lacks full context of deployment, rollback strategy and any related UI or connector dependencies.
